new.s:
Which of the following principles were common to the Bhakti and Sufi movements?
I. Monotheism
II. Asceticism
III. Religious tolerance
IV. Acceptance of idol worship
new.x: Monotheism, asceticism and religious tolerance were common to both, so I, II and III only (APPSC-G1 2022 and 2023 keys). Idol worship was not common: Sufis and the Nirguna saints rejected it, so every option with IV is wrong, and 'I and II only' leaves out tolerance.
new.tq: Bhakti-Sufi common: monotheism, asceticism, tolerance; idol worship is the trap.

2. Some Sufis adopted Hath-yogic techniques.

new.x: Both statements are correct (UPPSC 2019). Hath Yoga was practised by the Nathpanthi Kanphata yogis of Gorakhnath's tradition, and Sufis adopted its techniques, such as breath control after the Amritakund was translated. So 'Both 1 and 2'; the other options leave out a true statement.
